name: JV_CONTRIBUTION_REQUESTS_B_
description: This table contains joint venture partner contribution requests. These requests are used to create partner contributions for stakeholders.

columns.name: CONTRIBUTION_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the partner contribution request.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: REQUEST_SHORT_NAME
columns.description: Unique short name of the partner contribution request.

columns.name: JOINT_VENTURE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the joint venture assigned to the partner contribution request.

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: Start date of the partner contribution request.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: End date of the partner contribution request.

columns.name: OPEN_DISTRIBUTION_AMOUNT_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether to create partner contribution based on the open joint venture distribution amount.

columns.name: REQUEST_FREQUENCY_CODE
columns.description: The frequency of processing partner contribution requests. It is based on ORA_JV_REQUEST_FREQUENCY lookup codes such as Daily, Weekly, Monthly, and One-time.

columns.name: REQUESTED_GROSS_AMOUNT
columns.description: The gross amount on the partner contribution request from which partner contributions will be created.

columns.name: REQUEST_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the status of the partner contribution request. It is based on ORA_JV_REQUEST_STATUS lookup codes such as Initiated, Active, On hold, and Closed.

columns.name: STAKEHOLDER_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the stakeholder assigned to the partner contribution request.

columns.name: OWNERSHIP_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: The name of the ownership definition associated with the partner contribution request that will be used to identify stakeholders and their share of the contribution.

columns.name: WEEK_START_DAY_CODE
columns.description: Start day of the week on the partner contribution request. This is used when running the process to create partner contributions on a weekly frequency. It is based on ORA_JV_REQUEST_START_END_DAY lookup codes such as Saturday, Sunday, Monday, and so forth.

columns.name: WEEK_END_DAY_CODE
columns.description: Ending day of the week on the partner contribution request. This is used when running the process to create partner contributions on a weekly frequency. It is based on ORA_JV_REQUEST_START_END_DAY lookup codes such as Saturday, Sunday, Monday, and so forth.

columns.name: RUN_DAY_CODE
columns.description: Run day of the partner contribution request. It is based on ORA_JV_REQUEST_RUN_DAY lookup codes such as First day of the following week, Last day of the current week, First day of the following month, and Last day of the current month.

columns.name: REQUEST_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: The currency code that will be used to create partner contributions. If the currency is not available, the system populates the joint venture primary ledger currency as the default currency.

columns.name: CONVERSION_DATE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the currency conversion date. It is based on ORA_JV_REQUEST_CONVERSION_DATE lookup codes such as Partner Contribution Start Date and System Date.

columns.name: CONTRIBUTION_ACCOUNT_CCID
columns.description: Code combination identifier for the joint venture partner contribution account.

columns.name: LAST_RUN_DATE
columns.description: The date the partner contribution request was last processed successfully.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
